description_en: Queries the logs of a real-time data ingestion job for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 查询集群实时数据接入任务的日志详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-aps-action-logs --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2023-02-11T08:30Z --end-time 2023-02-11T09:30Z --workload-id aps-hz109vpvt4fg8528d0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApsActionLogs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the logs to be queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 日志的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the logs to be queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be specified is 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
日志的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。

查询日志时，结束时间需大于开始时间，且与开始时间最大间隔不超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the real-time data ingestion job
parameters.name: workload_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword that you want to use for fuzzy match in the query
parameters.help_zh: 查询的关键字。在日志查询时模糊匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The phase during which the logs to be queried were generated. Valid values:

StructureMigrate: schema migration.
FullDataSync: full data synchronization.
IncrementalSync: incremental data synchronization.

If you do not specify this parameter, logs of all the phases are queried
parameters.help_zh:
任务阶段。取值：

StructureMigrate：结构迁移。
FullDataSync：全量同步。
IncrementalSync：增量同步。

未指定该参数时，默认查询所有的任务阶段
parameters.name: stage

parameters.help_en:
The types of the logs. Separate multiple log types with commas (,). Valid values:

INFO
WARN
ERROR

If you do not specify this parameter, logs of all types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
日志类型。多个日志类型用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：

INFO：信息。
WARN：警告。
ERROR：错误。

未指定该参数时，默认查询所有的日志类型
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数。取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的正整数。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The information about the request denial
